filesChanged.change: MODIFIED: resolve() for a workspace with no recorded mode now derives { mode: 'selected', slugs: <owned skill slugs, normalized>, derived: true } and never 'all'. hasOwnedSkills() is replaced by ownedSkillSlugs(), which takes the last POSIX segment of every kind 'skill' manifest key across HARNESS_TARGET_IDS. A recorded mode, persist(), select() and enableAll() are unchanged. The header doc now states the new migration rule (#17, D-D4).

CREATED: unit spec over real ManagedManifestStore/HarnessStateStore in a temp workspace. Covers: owned slugs derived (deduped across targets, sorted, non-skill entries ignored); an unregistered target (vscode) counts; selected [] with no skill entries or no manifests; persist() records the derived allowlist and resolve() does not re-derive after the manifests are emptied; a recorded 'all' stays 'all' (persist cannot overwrite it); a recorded 'selected' keeps its own slugs, including [].

MODIFIED (ownership transferred to Batch 20 by the coordinator; no other batch lists it): only the 3 migration tests that encoded the old derived 'all' rule. THE MIGRATION: an owned skill-one gives selected ['skill-one']; skill-one still propagates and skill-two does not. Unregistered-target evidence: selected ['legacy-skill'] and nothing new propagates. Persisted decision: stays selected ['legacy-skill'] (derived:false) after the manifests are emptied, with no flip and no new propagation.

environmentalFailures.cause: The spec uses the fixed path WS_A = /home/amun/projects/alpha. Root resolution walks up to the nearest .ptah marker. On this machine /home/amun/projects/.ptah exists (user data, left untouched), so the root resolves to /home/amun/projects instead of /home/amun/projects/alpha. The spec was last changed in 313112496 and Batch 20 does not touch it.

decisions.decision: Slug = last POSIX segment of a kind 'skill' manifest key.
decisions.evidence: claude-target.ts:171 keys skills as `${SKILLS_REL}/${skill.slug}`. Manifest keys are workspace-relative POSIX paths (managed-manifest.ts ManagedManifestSchema). entry.source is diagnostic only.
